summary: A curated tour of deterministic charts, dashboards, maps, topology, hierarchy, and report-ready visual composition generated by ChartForgeX.

categories.label: Dashboards
categories.description: Composed report and operational dashboard surfaces.

categories.label: Charts
categories.description: Focused statistical, status, and flow visualizations.

categories.label: Visual systems
categories.description: Themes, typography, and reusable presentation foundations.

cases.title: Restaurant operations dashboard
cases.summary: A report-ready operations canvas combining weekly revenue, order status, customer patterns, occupation, and compact KPI summaries.
cases.alt: Restaurant operations dashboard with revenue trend, weekly summary, order status, customer distribution, and occupation charts arranged in a dark report grid.
cases.useCase: Combine several visual blocks into a single executive or operational report without relying on a browser charting runtime.

cases.title: SaaS revenue and retention dashboard
cases.summary: Monthly recurring revenue, movement drivers, churn context, and supporting KPI cards composed into one deterministic dashboard.
cases.alt: SaaS dashboard showing monthly recurring revenue, MRR drivers, customer movement, churn, and supporting KPI cards in a dark grid.
cases.useCase: Produce repeatable finance and product reporting for email, documentation, dashboards, and generated reports from the same model.

cases.title: Control coverage matrix
cases.summary: A heatmap that compares security domains across controls with semantic colors, readable labels, and an explicit value scale.
cases.alt: Dark security control coverage heatmap with domain rows, control columns, colored cells, percentage labels, and a semantic value scale.
cases.useCase: Turn a dense assessment matrix into a compact visual that remains readable in a report or exported image.

cases.title: Security posture radar
cases.summary: A dark-theme radar chart for comparing posture across identity, endpoint, data, network, application, and operational dimensions.
cases.alt: Dark radar chart comparing security posture scores across six security dimensions with a filled polygon and labeled axes.
cases.useCase: Show a multidimensional posture summary when the relationships between dimensions matter more than a ranked table.

cases.title: Finding remediation flow
cases.summary: A Sankey view tracing weighted findings from discovery through triage, ownership, remediation, and monitoring.
cases.alt: Light Sankey diagram with colored weighted flows connecting discovery, triage, ownership, remediation, and monitoring stages.
cases.useCase: Explain where work accumulates or drops out across a multi-stage operational process.

cases.title: Policy readiness progress
cases.summary: A compact circular progress visual with an explicit percentage, supporting label, and report-friendly light presentation.
cases.alt: Light circular policy readiness chart with a large percentage in the center and a labeled progress ring.
cases.useCase: Place a clear readiness or completion indicator inside a dashboard card, report strip, or status summary.

cases.title: Europe revenue map
cases.summary: A dotted geographic map that encodes regional revenue with value-colored points, labels, and a report-oriented viewport.
cases.alt: Light map of Europe with country and city labels, colored revenue markers, and a legend explaining the value scale.
cases.useCase: Add geographic context to business or operational metrics without loading a browser mapping library.

cases.title: Geographic infrastructure topology
cases.summary: A topology-native geographic layout with projected site markers, curved WAN routes, regional callouts, selection state, and metadata hooks.
cases.alt: World topology map with regional infrastructure sites, curved WAN connections, status labels, and an APAC site selected for detail.
cases.useCase: Explain site connectivity and route health while keeping the output suitable for static reports and interactive HTML hosts.

cases.title: Organization hierarchy with branch policies
cases.summary: An organization chart generated from parent-child member data with standard, compact, and vertical layout policies applied to individual branches.
cases.alt: Organization hierarchy with a leadership row and multiple team branches using standard, compact, and vertical arrangements without overlapping cards.
cases.useCase: Render dense team or directory hierarchies while choosing the most readable layout for each subtree.

cases.title: Interactive replication route explorer
cases.summary: A site-to-site replication mesh with selectable scenarios, ordered route steps, offender highlighting, scoped URL state, and host-ready events.
cases.alt: Replication mesh showing regional directory sites, bidirectional links, health status, route metrics, and a highlighted scenario path.
cases.useCase: Start with the same deterministic topology used for SVG and PNG, then add browser-side exploration for incident review or live directory tooling.

cases.title: Theme and typography showcase
cases.summary: A single comparison grid demonstrating theme palettes, font choices, density, contrast, and consistent chart composition.
cases.alt: Grid of ChartForgeX charts rendered with several themes and font combinations for side-by-side typography and palette comparison.
cases.useCase: Choose and verify a visual system before applying it across dashboards, reports, documentation, or branded exports.

cases.title: PowerBGInfo endpoint snapshot
cases.summary: A wide endpoint-status composition designed for Windows background deployment, combining device identity, health, storage, network, and support context.
cases.alt: Wide endpoint status strip with computer identity, operating system, health, storage, network, and support information arranged for a Windows desktop background.
cases.useCase: Use ChartForgeX composition primitives through PowerBGInfo to place support-ready device context directly on managed Windows desktops.
